basis: The dashboard is a dual-axis line chart with independent scales for the 2011 and 2030 series. There are no numeric tick labels or a shared metric name to establish that vertical position encodes a comparable cost magnitude. This is confirmed by the 'Nuclear power plant construction' category, where the 2030 marker is visually lower on the page but has a higher labeled value (53 vs 31). Consequently, the visual difference in height at the 'Service' category cannot be used to determine which year has the higher cost.
option_label: Route Service to routine year-over-year archive review
